why_use_section.title: Why We Engineer with Automation Tools
why_use_section.subtitle: Make, n8n, and Zapier give teams fast, maintainable ways to connect systems and automate handoffs.
paragraphs: Automation platforms are ideal when business teams need reliable workflows without waiting for full custom software cycles. We use Make for visual orchestration, n8n for flexible self-hostable workflow logic, and Zapier for fast SaaS-to-SaaS integrations.

Our automation work combines low-code speed with engineering discipline: clear trigger design, error handling, logging, data validation, and API-first patterns that make workflows dependable in production.
